scope: seed42 only; one pilot A/B then conditional full B and independent full A
initialization: build_six(42)[S23], independent identical values/storage, no pilot or parent trained weights

sources.K: per-source calibrated_sensor camera_intrinsic, composed half-pixel resize1600x900 ->1024x576 ->128x72
sources.dt: actual source/target integer microseconds; historical feature dt unchanged and separately exactly validated
sources.rotation: source/target nuScenes ego_pose orientations; constant extra uncertain supervision, not model input
sources.extrinsics: per-source and per-target calibrated_sensor rotations and camera lever arms
sources.plane: source-frame road homography decomposition with independently observed ego rotation; no speed-prediction residual support selection
sources.metric_scale: plane through source ego ground projection, actual calibrated_sensor lever translation; local planar approximation
sources.static_support: fixed pretrained Cityscapes road class, source and warped-target erosion/probability plus flow-plane coherence
sources.reliability: finite existing RAFT valid and source/warped-target semantic consistency plus independent homography residual; valid is not semantic support

units.velocities: m/s target yaw-plane ego ground-projection reference
units.residual: flow_uv/(fx_dt,fy_dt), normalized image motion rate s^-1

loss.geometry: SmoothL1(normalized flow residual,beta0.01); mean point+axis per valid window, zero invalid, mean ALL batch windows
loss.lambda_rule: one median initial output-gradient ratio, target10%, four fixed epoch0 pilot train batches

policy.support: source+warped-target frozen road probability, eroded boundaries; finite valid RAFT and independent planar coherence
policy.plane: visual homography decomposition selected by offline rotation and nominal upward sign; passes source ego ground projection
policy.scale: actual calibrated_sensor translation; ego origin ground projection per official devkit issue161
policy.missing_geometry: invalid reason; all windows retained; padded points always masked

gradient: only predicted vx/vy and existing S23 readout; all geometry masks/observations/calibration/depth/rotation detached
auto_gate: passed short checks + finite nonzero constraint + no source/time errors + pilot B best all-dev EPE <= A best *1.01; real queued FULL_B waits full cache and remote stage publication
caveats: Extra offline pose/geometric/semantic supervision is not excluded as a cause of improvement.
Pose is uncertain; plane and static semantics are approximations.
Endpoint instantaneous speed explains only last pair as short-interval approximation.
No CG offset is known; no label change or CG/true sideslip claim.
